name: @hhcp/contract-tests
description: Golden-response contract parity harness (analysis §16). Runs the same request set against BOTH backends (Python :8000 and Node :8001), which share ONE database, and diffs status + response body. Also asserts the security-parity (§16.3) and behavioral-parity (§16.4) cases. This is the mechanism that proves 'zero frontend changes' and behavioral equivalence rather than asserting them.
